```
import pytest
from smolagents.local_python_executor import LocalPythonExecutor, InterpreterError

def test_unauthorized_import_logs(caplog):
    exec = LocalPythonExecutor(authorized_imports=["math"])
    code = "import os"
    with caplog.at_level("DEBUG"):
        with pytest.raises(InterpreterError) as exc:
            exec(code)
        # check message
        assert "Forbidden access to module: os" in str(exc.value)
    # check log
    assert any("Attempted unauthorized import: os" in record.message for record in caplog.records)
```
